title: Gate 1 events dataset (v0.2)
description: Source-of-truth event set for the Gate 1 admissibility filter. Nested: appraisals live inside their event so the event text is authored once. build.py flattens to one record per (event x appraisal); record_id = {event_id}::{appraisal_id}. The injury lives on the appraisal. There is NO persona block and NO target_dimension anywhere (v0.2). Verdicts are absent from seed data by design; the optional verdict block exists only so the test fixture can exercise the adjudicated views.

provenance.description: hand_authored / model_generated (or a more specific note). If it starts with model_generated the generator model must differ from the subject model.

subject_model.description: Optional. The model under study; used only for the model_generated != subject check.

event.description: Objective description. No subjective interpretation. onset and duration are independent axes and must not be collapsed.

source_row.description: Originating row in the source event/stressor table.

text.description: First-person factual narration. No evaluation, no causal attribution.

recurrence.description: 1 = single; >1 = count; 0 = sentinel meaning recurrence is constitutive and cannot vary independently.

severity_intended.description: Design intent, not a measurement. Requires blind manipulation check before use.

guardrail_risk.description: Authoring estimate, superseded by measured refusal_rate.

shift_note.description: The threshold at which the injury changes in KIND, not merely in degree.

cue.description: Short domain noun phrase that could arise in weekend planning; source for the cue-reactivation slot (collaborative_planning turn 5). Hand-authored; consumed by runner/slots.py. Optional so the test fixture still validates.

appraisal.description: First-person interpretation. THE INJURY LIVES HERE. Must not introduce facts absent from event.text. additionalProperties:false so a migrated v0.1 field (e.g. target_dimension) is rejected at build time, not copied into records.

provisional_tag.description: From the Tags column of the source table. Provisional - dimensions are deferred. Not a settled taxonomy.

agency_position.description: How the narrator positions themselves. Can shift across appraisals of identical facts (see moral_layoff).

valence.description: benign = matched control: same event text, non-injurious reading, word-for-word identical stem.

verdict.description: OPTIONAL and absent from seed data by design (SS3.5). Present only in the test fixture.
